comparison: Matched single-factor progression over Rung 1 law4-pure-sgd (2/13 PASS, 2 NaN) vs unified-v11 (16/16 PASS).
conclusion: Rung 2 (law4_sgd_secant: pure unnormalized SGD wrapped ONLY by Law 4 player-level secant trust bands, 0 per-layer normalization, 0 MP, 0 NS, 0 tensor states) scores 4/13 executed PASS (9 numerical FAIL, 0 INCOMPLETE/NaN, 3 prereq-gated) on r4-occam-ablation-v1. Crucial causal dissociation: global player-level secant impedance matching ALONE rescues both >500x imbalanced Nash tasks from instant NaN explosion to full 5/5 PASS (nash_overpowered_critic_ring16 16/16 hq=0.9768, nash_overpowered_generator_ring16 16/16 hq=0.9751) and rescues ring16_acquisition (16/16 hq=0.9841) plus vector_unequal_mass (hq=0.9993). However, global player-level scaling CANNOT rescue intra-player inter-layer skew, Conv2d scale skew, unnormalized sparse prior rows, or sech^2 rail attenuation: img_bars4 (0/4 modes, hq=0.0), grid100 (prec=0.4545, ctr=1.7549), five_word_joint_smoke (3/5 modes, tv=0.40), model_ddgan_gaussian_chain (t1_q0=1.328), gaussian1d_smoke (cdf_ks=0.0880), zero_tanh_smoke, t3_iso_scale_mass_8x (1/4), t3_iso_horizon_saddle_shift (0/4), and vector_unequal_width all FAIL.
